source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Authenticated storage encryption, hardware-backed key protection where supported, integrity checking.
requirements.limitation: Tests cannot establish algorithm strength or side-channel resistance.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review platform-specific key protection, runtime integrity and independent security evidence.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The design specifies storage protections, but independent platform and security evidence is needed to establish resistance to unauthorized use; migration and recovery risks are related, not exhaustive.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Encryption in transit and at rest, no plaintext logs/caches, isolated processing.
requirements.limitation: Platform-specific exposure vectors and deployment variation remain.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect logs, temporary files, processing isolation and actual runtime configurations.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The design prohibits plaintext exposure and requires isolation; observed logs, temporary storage and processing configuration are needed to establish enforcement.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Technical enforcement where feasible, justified policy exceptions and periodic review.
requirements.limitation: Automated checks cannot establish feasibility; capability evolves.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review exception rationale, implementation and reassessment evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Policy-only compliance mistaken for enforced protection.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Technical enforcement and justified exceptions are stated; implementation and reassessment records are necessary to determine whether exception claims are supported.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Platform-strongest key protection, authenticated encryption, integrity checks and tamper response, software fallback.
requirements.limitation: Physical tampering and platform variation incompletely tested.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise tamper detection and response, compare hardware/software properties and recovery outcomes.
requirements.potential_harm: Tampering enables unauthorized use or lockout.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The required protection varies with platform capability, so implementation-specific tamper and recovery evidence is needed rather than a further general design statement.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Online and offline presentation; offline must have no hidden network dependency.
requirements.limitation: Finite network/device combinations and regression exposure.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise disconnected devices, DNS/status/telemetry absence and compatible verification.
requirements.potential_harm: Offline access failure or stale-status acceptance.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Offline presentation is required; disconnected execution and traffic observations are needed to establish absence of hidden network dependency.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Holder-only presentation log of attributes, recipient and timestamp; holder-only access/export/deletion; no provider access.
requirements.limitation: Covert OS/firmware exfiltration or later capability changes not excluded.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect recipient attribution, holder-only access, export/deletion and backups/telemetry; reconcile with audit obligations.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Holder-exclusive logging is stated; access, export, deletion and backup evidence is needed to establish whether another actor can obtain presentation history.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Review/deselect attributes, transmit only selected attributes, cryptographic hiding of others.
requirements.limitation: UI usability and all combinations not established.
requirements.evidence_needed: Compare request, holder selection, actual payload and cryptographic disclosure; assess usability.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Selective transmission and hiding are explicit; actual payload and cryptographic evidence must establish that holder choice controls disclosure.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Age predicate UI and boolean result, no actual age or birth date; metadata resistance.
requirements.limitation: Finite thresholds/formats and emerging cryptographic vulnerabilities.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise boundaries, repeated requests and leakage; check understandable distinction from full disclosure.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The boolean age output is specified; boundary, repeated-query and metadata evidence are needed to establish it without disclosing extra attributes.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Attribute access only in holder-initiated presentation, no background indexing/analytics or attribute telemetry.
requirements.limitation: Runtime coverage cannot exclude every hidden or future access path.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect background jobs, SDKs and network traces; clarify maintenance operations against access restriction.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The scope of permitted maintenance operations under holder-initiated access needs clarification before background activity can be judged authorized.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Pre-processing conspicuous notice of collection, use, purpose and retention in understandable language.
requirements.limitation: Automated presence checks cannot establish conspicuousness or comprehension.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review notice timing, accessibility, actual downstream purposes and retention; test comprehension without collecting personal data.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Notice must precede processing; observed timing, accessibility and actual downstream use are necessary to determine whether the notice is accurate and meaningful.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: No profiling, advertising, analytics endpoints, secondary stores or monetization; primary-purpose policy.
requirements.limitation: Testing cannot exclude all server-side or future flows.
requirements.evidence_needed: Trace actual data lineage, provider SDKs, policies and secondary processing paths.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Secondary processing is prohibited; observed data lineage, SDKs and secondary stores are needed to establish whether monetization or profiling paths exist.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 4_ Digital Wallet Providers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Compliance programme, current attestations and handling consistent with cited Utah data protection statutes.
requirements.limitation: Legal applicability and operational practices require qualified review.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review applicable obligations, attestations and implemented controls; no legal conclusion.
requirements.potential_harm: SEDI conformance incorrectly substituted for statutory compliance.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The compliance programme is required; applicable obligations, attestations and implemented controls are necessary evidence, not a legal determination.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 5_ Verifiers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Encrypted transfer and temporary storage, no persistence beyond transaction needs, security baseline.
requirements.limitation: Tests cannot establish full security posture or all configurations.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect transaction boundary, storage expiry, security baseline and deployments.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Transfer and temporary storage protections are specified; actual transaction boundaries, expiry and configuration evidence are needed to establish them.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 5_ Verifiers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Technical enforcement where feasible, documented policy exceptions and review.
requirements.limitation: Technical feasibility requires judgment; later capabilities change.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect feasibility and control implementation, exceptions and review triggers.
requirements.potential_harm: Unsupported claim of enforced verification obligations.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Feasible technical enforcement and exception documentation are required; actual controls and exception reassessment evidence are needed before judging sufficiency.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 5_ Verifiers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: No plaintext logging or transaction-exceeding cache; isolation and access control.
requirements.limitation: Review covers limited deployment environments.
requirements.evidence_needed: Trace attribute exposure, logs and unauthorized internal access.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Logging and caching restrictions are explicit; observed logs and internal access paths are needed to establish whether attributes persist or are exposed.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 5_ Verifiers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Explicit bounded requests matching RP purpose; no wildcard or incidental processing.
requirements.limitation: Request matching does not establish necessity of stated purpose.
requirements.evidence_needed: Bind RP purpose, requested set and holder selection; reject wildcard, mismatch and incidental data.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Purpose-bounded requests are required; actual request, purpose and holder-selection bindings are needed to establish rejection of excessive requests.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 5_ Verifiers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Four sequential processing conditions: holder authorization, necessity, notice and consent; fail closed including fallback.
requirements.limitation: Notice comprehension and real necessity not established by automated gate tests.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise each missing condition, changed purpose/recipient, replay, error and fallback; inspect actual processing before gate.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The processing prerequisites are enumerated; negative and cross-actor execution evidence is needed to establish that no path processes before all conditions hold.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 5_ Verifiers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Contactless or remote verification without device transfer or docking.
requirements.limitation: Field practice can diverge from protocol testing.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise proximity/remote flows and observe informal surrender demands.
requirements.potential_harm: Device surrender exposes information or enables tampering.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Device transfer is prohibited; representative interaction and service evidence are needed to determine whether informal transfer demands undermine the design.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 5_ Verifiers _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Applicable external privacy obligations integrated into procedures; SEDI not a substitute.
requirements.limitation: Legal interpretation and actual practices outside mechanical validation.
requirements.evidence_needed: Qualified legal/compliance review and operational evidence.
requirements.disposition_rationale: External privacy obligations remain applicable; qualified obligation review and actual processing evidence are necessary before assessing compliance.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Protect verified attributes in transit and at rest, restrict access and apply security baseline.
requirements.limitation: Integration tests do not cover full internal infrastructure.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect internal data flows, access and security baseline.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Attribute protection is required; actual data flows, access and deployed security configuration are needed to establish effective protection.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Enforce requirements technically where feasible; justified policy exceptions and periodic review.
requirements.limitation: Technical feasibility not established by tests.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect exception rationale, controls and reassessment.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The enforcement and exception obligation is stated; actual control evidence and exception decisions are needed to establish whether policy is an adequate substitute.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Secure processing, no unnecessary plaintext logging, transaction-bounded caching, purpose-limited retention.
requirements.limitation: Internal RP handling beyond integration boundary not fully testable.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect actual logs and necessity basis, downstream access, retention and secure context; distinguish verifier stricter no-plaintext rule.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The distinction between necessary secure logging and the verifier's stricter plaintext restriction needs clarification before observed log contents can be classified.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Document purpose, request only proportionate mapped attributes, retain only as necessary.
requirements.limitation: Mapping tests cannot establish reasonable necessity.
requirements.evidence_needed: Challenge purpose and field necessity; compare actual request, verifier and retention.
requirements.potential_harm: Unnecessary disclosure under nominal purpose mapping.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Purpose and proportionality are stated; actual requests and retention records are needed to determine whether collection exceeds the declared purpose.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Four sequential processing conditions including specified purpose and conspicuous notice; no bypass.
requirements.limitation: Automated checks cannot establish human understanding; administrative checks cannot establish runtime enforcement.
requirements.evidence_needed: Test missing conditions and changed purpose/recipient across actor boundaries; inspect error/fallback branches.
requirements.potential_harm: RP processes without actual authorization or necessity.
requirements.disposition_rationale: The prerequisite sequence is defined; execution evidence across actor boundaries and fallback paths is needed to establish that processing does not precede authorization.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: No device surrender, contactless or remote workflow, no staff handover instruction and full service availability.
requirements.limitation: Informal field practices outside finite tests.
requirements.evidence_needed: Observe actual service and alternative pathways; test device-transfer refusal.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Device custody and service continuity are specified; representative service observations are needed to establish that refusing device transfer does not exclude a person.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Document permissive acceptance and applicable legal proof requirements.
requirements.limitation: Business/legal decision outside technical boundary; context changes.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review actor-specific applicability and legal exceptions, including GOV-06 health-provider obligations; do not infer blanket exemption.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Clarification is needed on the relationship between permissive relying-party acceptance and specific actor obligations before an acceptance test can establish the intended boundary.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 6_ Relying Parties _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Applicable external privacy obligations integrated; SEDI not a substitute.
requirements.limitation: Legal interpretation and actual practices require independent review.
requirements.evidence_needed: Qualified review of applicable law and actual processing; no legal determination.
requirements.disposition_rationale: External privacy obligations are not displaced; qualified review and actual processing evidence are needed rather than assuming SEDI conformance suffices.

cases.constructed: Wallet displays and captures consent for a bounded request, but recipient or purpose changes before verifier/RP processing; each component has a locally satisfied gate.
cases.evidence: Bind actual purpose, recipient, requested and selected attributes to authorization and consent; test mismatched context, replay, missing conditions, early processing and fallback across actors. No claim that source mandates a specific binding protocol.

cases.constructed: Holder-only log works locally, but provider backup or diagnostic integration exposes presentation history.
cases.evidence: Inspect holder-only access, export, irreversible deletion, backups, SDKs and audit evidence boundaries; distinguish user-controlled history from program audit.

cases.constructed: Verifier clears transaction cache, but downstream RP logs plaintext attributes or retains them for a different purpose.
cases.evidence: Trace end-to-end copies and purposes; assess each actor's distinct obligations, plaintext logging limitation and secondary processing authority. Do not impose verifier wording on RP without source interpretation.

cases.constructed: Qualifying health provider invokes general permissive RP acceptance to reject SEDI without examining specific obligations or exemptions.
cases.evidence: Determine applicable roles, funding/system thresholds, issuance-based deadline and authorized exemption; no blanket legal conclusion.

limitations: Existing risk hypotheses reused; no new canonical or local risk IDs needed.

RPY-03 objective 1 qualifies plaintext logging by necessity, whereas VER-03 objective 1 prohibits plaintext logging at any point. Preserve actor-specific wording and seek clarification of RP necessity boundary.
RPY-08 permissive acceptance must be examined alongside specific government/health-provider obligations, not treated as universal exemption.
No actual deployment evidence, legal conclusion, risk scoring or verified guardrails.
